mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness and recessionary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 105) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 265) indicates stagflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105 and CPIAUCSL > 265.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates strong economic growth and potential inflation, triggering aggressive monetary policy that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 1800) indicates robust consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800.
